t: What Catalyst Performance Database Is All About
title: What Catalyst Performance Database Is All About
description: Catalysts accelerate reactions without being consumed, by offering lower-energy pathways. Performance is measured three ways: activity (rate per site, turnover frequency), selectivity (desired product vs side products), and stability (lifetime before deactivation). Platinum in catalytic converters, zeolites in oil refining, and nitrogenase in nature all do the same job: lower the barrier. This database is the complete catalyst: full records with definitions, key facts, procedures, and runnable demo programs, organized on a teaching ladder from Foundations to Advanced.
definition: Catalyst Performance Database: a complete reference database of full catalyst records.
key_points: What this database holds: full catalyst records, each with definition, key facts, and a runnable demo program.

t: Core Vocabulary of Catalyst Performance Database
title: Core Vocabulary of Catalyst Performance Database
description: Every field has its own language. These are the working terms of Catalyst Performance Database — learn them first and every later record reads faster: turnover frequency: reactions per site per second; selectivity: fraction of product going the desired way; promoter: additive boosting catalyst performance; poisoning: deactivation by strongly bound impurities.
definition: The working vocabulary of Catalyst Performance Database: the terms practitioners actually use.
key_points: turnover frequency: reactions per site per second
selectivity: fraction of product going the desired way
promoter: additive boosting catalyst performance
poisoning: deactivation by strongly bound impurities
active site: the exact atoms where reaction happens
heterogeneous catalysis: catalyst in a different phase from reactants
